result.instructions: Tools for SimplyMeet.me, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our event types are enabled, and how long is each one?"; "Show me the bookings on the calendar for next week."; "What slots are free for our 30-minute consultation next Tuesday in Europe/Prague?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SimplyMeet.me data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run simplymeet_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run simplymeet_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run simplymeet_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. simplymeet_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: simplymeet_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Return the SimplyMeet.me user that owns the API key (name, email, time zone). Good first call to check the connection. API: GET /panel/api/current-user.

tools.name: simplymeet_list_event_types
tools.title: List event types
tools.description: List the booking event types (meeting types) on the account: name, duration, location, status. Use the ids with simplymeet_get_event_type_availability. API: GET /panel/api/event-type.

user_id.description: Only event types of this user id.

tools.name: simplymeet_get_event_type
tools.title: Get an event type
tools.description: Get one event type by id, including its duration, location type, timezone and questions. API: GET /panel/api/event-type/{id}.

tools.name: simplymeet_get_event_type_availability
tools.title: Get free slots for an event type
tools.description: List the bookable time slots for one event type between two dates. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; pass a time zone name such as Europe/Prague. API: GET /panel/api/event-type/availability/{id}.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example Europe/Prague.

duration_id.description: Duration id, for flexible-duration event types.

user_id.description: User id, for team event types.

annotations.title: Get free slots for an event type

tools.name: simplymeet_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List booked events, one page at a time, newest first by default. Returns meta (paging) and items (events with invitee, event type and cancellation). API: GET /panel/api/event/.

tools.name: simplymeet_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Get one booked event by id: time, event type, invitee, participants, answers and cancellation. API: GET /panel/api/event/{id}.

tools.name: simplymeet_cancel_event
tools.title: Cancel an event
tools.description: Cancel one booked event by id, with an optional reason. Set cancel_following to also cancel the later events of a recurring booking. The event is cancelled on the account; this cannot be undone here. API: PUT /panel/api/event/cancel/{id}.

reason.description: Reason for the cancellation, shown on the event.

cancel_following.description: Also cancel the following events of a recurring booking.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with SimplyMeet.me
prompts.description: What you can do with SimplyMeet.me here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_open_slots_for_a_meeting_type
prompts.title: Check open slots for a meeting type
prompts.description: List the event types. Then read the open slots of one type between two dates, in your time zone.

prompts.name: review_the_bookings_for_next_week
prompts.title: Review the bookings for next week
prompts.description: List the booked events. Open one to see its time, invitee and answers.

prompts.name: cancel_a_booking
prompts.title: Cancel a booking
prompts.description: Read the event first. Then cancel it with a reason. Cancel the later events of a recurring booking if needed.
